# Advanced Exchange settings use hidden persisted fields to reach the incoming server

The advanced dialog copies amsa_persist controls to its shared settings object. Its closing callback copies the endpoint to a hidden wsm_persist field and dispatches prefchange. Account Manager parses the persisted field ID as a server type and property, then writes the destination interface property. These hidden fields carry settings data; they are not spare visible inputs. Current shared Exchange markup keeps the proxy explicitly hidden and uses exchangeUrl, while the native getter/setter still stores ews_url. The original test checks mutation and final restoration but its intermediate reopened-field assertions use the old input variable. No live settings or EWS request was run.

Scope: Account Settings advanced-dialog persistence.
